description: Draft customer-support email dataset requiring human review. All emails, labels and summaries were generated by an LLM and are NOT independently human-verified ground truth.

cases.input:
Hi, I was charged twice for my monthly subscription on the 3rd. There are two identical $29.00 charges on my card statement. Could you refund the extra one? Thanks,
Maria
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports being charged twice for their monthly subscription on the 3rd and asks for the duplicate charge to be refunded.
cases.notes: Duplicate charge and refund request; clearly a payment issue.

cases.input: The app crashes as soon as I open it on my iPhone 14. It started right after the last update. Please fix this.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that the app crashes immediately on launch on their iPhone 14 since the latest update.
cases.notes: Clear crash report tied to an update.

cases.input: Fantastic, you charged me twice for the same month. I always wanted to pay double for exactly the same thing. Please refund the extra charge.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer complains about being charged twice for the same month and requests a refund of the extra charge.
cases.notes: Edge case: sarcastic. Fantastic and wanting to pay double express dissatisfaction, not praise or consent; the actual request is refunding the duplicate charge.
